definitions.explanation: An exit designated for use during emergencies, marked with distinctive green signs.

examples.japanese: {非常口|ひじょうぐち}の{位置|いち}を{確認|かくにん}してください。
examples.english: Please check the location of the emergency exit.

examples.japanese: {飛行機|ひこうき}に{乗|の}ったら、まず{非常口|ひじょうぐち}を{確認|かくにん}する。
examples.english: When boarding a plane, I first check where the emergency exit is.

examples.japanese: {非常口|ひじょうぐち}は{常|つね}に{開|あ}けておいてください。
examples.english: Please always keep the emergency exit clear.

notes:
FORMATION:
{非常|ひじょう} (emergency) + {口|ぐち} (exit/entrance)

SIGN:
Emergency exits in Japan are marked with a green pictogram showing a running figure. This follows international standards (ISO 7010).

COLLOCATIONS:
・{非常口|ひじょうぐち}を{確認|かくにん}する - to check the emergency exit
・{非常口|ひじょうぐち}の{表示|ひょうじ} - emergency exit sign
・{非常口|ひじょうぐち}から{避難|ひなん}する - to evacuate through the emergency exit
・{非常口|ひじょうぐち}を{塞|ふさ}ぐ - to block the emergency exit (prohibited)

RELATED TERMS:
・{避難|ひなん}{経路|けいろ} - evacuation route
・{非常|ひじょう}{階段|かいだん} - emergency stairs
・{誘導灯|ゆうどうとう} - emergency guidance light
